arya: Heads up — regression on the causal path observed in last deploy, p99 latency up ~2.1x for some workloads :eyes:

miguel: which kernel path? flashv3 or sdpa fallback?

arya: kernel_picker log shows v3 probe deciding flashv3 but then falling back to sdpa_v2 for head_dim=30 and seq_len>1024. repro on sm90 nodes.

lisa: can you paste the picker trace?

arya: ```
[2026-03-17T12:01:03Z] probe: model=redwood/rtd-3 head_dim=30 seqlen=1536 hw=sm90 -> probe_score=0.72 -> choose: flashv3
[2026-03-17T12:01:03Z] runtime: flashv3 init failed (unaligned head remap) -> fallback to sdpa_v2 (slowpath)
[2026-03-17T12:01:03Z] perf: chosen_kernel=sdpa_v2 p99_ms=312 baseline_ms=145
```

noah: hmm unaligned head remap... we saw similar on head sizes not divisible by 8. Is this the same margin we disabled in v3 autotune? :thinking:

miguel: my local microprobe showed a kernel probe mismatch: the kernel_selection heuristic applies a mask for causal padbucketizer which flips when (head_dim % 8 != 0) and seqlen>1024. Probably a codepath regression in the new stride optimizer.

arya: @miguel typo: you mean @noah? :)

miguel: yes, sorry. @noah can you check the stride optimizer commits from yesterday? I suspect the kernel probe now returns transient false negatives on sm90 when prefetch alignment fails.

noah: pulling commit diff now. also running quick perf job: small batch of rtd-3 with seqlen sweep.

infra-bot: perf-job-3179 started by noah — https://ci.redwood.ai/perf/3179 :rocket:

perf-bot: baseline-run(earlier): p99=148ms | current-run: p99=305ms | regression: +157ms (106%) — auto-create issue? :warning:

lisa: please also attach kv-cache heatmap. I want to check if kv warmup triggers different kernel paths.

arya: attached quick kv cache traces and microprofile in the perf job. kv/cache hits spike at step 2, then kernel flips.

miguel: action items: 1) add extra logging in kernel_picker for head_dim misalignment, 2) add unit test reproducing flashv3 init failure on head_dim%8!=0, 3) roll back stride optimizer patch if confirmed. I'll open the issue.

miguel: creating issue — https://tracker.redwood.ai/ISSUE-2145 — assigned to @noah and @miguel

noah: running repro patch now to force flashv3 to skip the unaligned early-fail and see if that stabilizes latency.

arya: thanks. will monitor perf-job. ping here when you have results :thumbsup:
